## Goal / acceptance criteria
Describe the 0.3.x app in `USER_GUIDE.md`: the Today screen (one card + 'More'), the 'Is this you?' card with 'Yes, this is me' / 'No, this is not me' and what each does, the optional phone-call note, the Google and Bing steps, and large text. Quote button labels exactly as the app shows them (check `src/freemyid/wizard/`), cite file:line in HTML comments, keep 'requested'/'confirmed' wording, no 'nothing is sent' claims.

Fake data only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Tests must pass on Windows too: `tmp_path` and `pathlib`, no hard-coded `/tmp` or POSIX-only paths. A real product bug = strict `xfail` with the reason plus a file:line finding in VENDOR_STATUS.md; never edit `src/`. Check existing tests first (`tests/`, `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/`, `tests/grok/`) and don't duplicate a guard.
